translation.module:
---- MODULE Inc ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
(* --algorithm Inc
variables total = 0;
process worker \in 1..N
variables tmp = 0;
begin

  Inc:
    total := totl + 1;

end process;
end algorithm; *)
\* BEGIN TRANSLATION (chksum(pcal) = "959d2a60" /\ chksum(tla) = "f79655a9")
VARIABLES total, pc, tmp

vars == << total, pc, tmp >>

ProcSet == (1..N)

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ total = 0
        (* Process worker *)
        /\ tmp = [self \in 1..N |-> 0]
        /\ pc = [self \in ProcSet |-> "Inc"]

Inc(self) == /\ pc[self] = "Inc"
             /\ total' = totl + 1
             /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"]
             /\ tmp' = tmp

worker(self) == Inc(self)

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == /\ \A self \in ProcSet: pc[self] = "Done"
               /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == (\E self \in 1..N: worker(self))
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(\A self \in ProcSet: pc[self] = "Done")

\* END TRANSLATION 

Done == \A p \in 1..N : pc[p] = "Done"
Correct == Done => total = N
====
